player_prompt.intro:
Tewi d aneggaru {player_id} deg Tic Tac Toe Imɣan.
Deg ṭṭafat inek, teṭṭafareḍ ad tɛeggeḍ 'X' neɣ 'O' deg tegnit yudren.
Tewi d netṭuḍ deg tɣimit n yimṛawen (X neɣ O) deg uḍebsi.
Tewi d netṭuḍ s yisem n yimṛawen.
Meṣṣeḍ aṭṭafat inek s tɣuri '[X 4]' ad tɛeggeḍ X deg tegnit tamenzut.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aɛeggal ur yeɛnan. Sken '[X 4]' neɣ '[O 2]' n tɣuri.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Uṭṭun n tzelɣa ur nelli ara d win: {cell}. Ilaq ad yili gar 0 ar 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Aḥeddad ur nlaq ara. Tazrawt {cell} tella yakan tettwaṭṭef.
